newsitem.title: USA: Continental cuts fares up to 40 percent.
newsitem.headline: Continental cuts fares up to 40 percent.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said on Tuesday that it is cutting fares by up to 40 percent from regular fares in select U.S. and international markets.
U.S. fare discounts apply to travel between January 6 and April 30, 1997, Continental said. European fares require travel between January 13 and March 15, 1997, the carrier said.
Round-trip tickets must be purchased by December 13, 1996 and within 24 hours of making a reservation for U.S. travel and within 72 hours for Europe travel, Continental said.
